Wanda: Yes, Wanda is as mad as a hatter but she's great fun to watch. Never shy, if Wanda thinks something she either says it or does it immediately.
Wanita: Wanita tries to be prompt and on time, at least, this is what she tells us. Why then does she tend to leave most of her important chores to the last minute? No wonder she turns up looking stressed, or in pain at having crashed into a doorway or a chair with her foot or her lower leg. Some advice from up here in the commentary box Wanita - have you heard of these things called lists? They're handy, especially if you're a busy beaver, which you seem to be most of the time.
Warneta: She's a complicated beast, this one. Rarely relaxed, Warneta needs a lot more laughs in her day and possibly a lot more sex. For a long time, sadly, her sex life provided great hilarity - have you met her husband? - but there is always room for improvement. I'd begin by doing something silly every day. Indulge your inner child, my girl. Only good will come of it!
Wendy: Like a shower that seems to have a personality all to itself, Wendy is scattered, lively and occasionally slightly awkward.
Whitney: Whitney was spoilt as a child and this had dire ramifications later in life.
Wilara: Spineless? Not this girl. Wilara dives into projects and into people, eager to get a foot-hold so she can get moving, loving or laughing. She does like to form a decent game plan before events commence, which is wise, although she deals with change and unexpected outcomes brilliantly. She'd make an excellent war strategist, although as a peace-lover she'd struggle with some of the decisions she would have to make.
Wilhelmina: A sexual juggernaut, Wilhelmina is humorous and experimental. Her mind whizzes at 100 miles per hour no matter how large her smile is, which isn’t to say she’s thinking bad thoughts. She’s just intelligent and her mind rarely stops, that’s all. A dangerous cook.
Willa: To describe her as rare is to say nothing. Her name is competently off the ground and gliding like very few others, although there is more to it than that. She might even be the world’s first female Dalai Lama. Let’s just watch and wait but she is an uncompromising competitor.
Willamina:
She’s a haiku at a bush poetry meet. 
She’s a flash of panties at Mass. 
She’s the confusion betwixt style and class. 
She’s the girl that cut you down before she ran out of town. 
She’s talked about in bars and conference rooms from Argentina to Morocco and from Perth to Paris. 
She’s eaten camel flesh and the hearts of Princes, and she’s been chased by sharks and Indonesian cops.
No one and nothing has yet caught her, and they won’t until she lets them…
Willie: The classical airs and graces of a polite feminie lady are absolutely none of her business.
Willora: Like a rip old egg-laden salmon not long for this world, Willora’s aspirations are pretty simple and she moves through life like the aforementioned fish swimming steadily upstream to spawn. Barring catastrophe she’ll get there.
Willow: Zany, crazy, hyperactive and dangerous? Probably, but like the tree, Willow, can be thoughtful, unusual, curvy and genuine. Depends what day of the week it is, really. Willow is sufficiently unbelievable, but be prepared for a wrestle.
Wilma: Christ she's sick of housework. In fact, she's so sick of it she left. Last I heard she was in a bar in Paris snogging a young man from Portugal, god love her!
Wiloughby: No, she’s not a a wallaby, but Wiloughby would make a wonderful ecologist if so inclined. She’s very bright, she cares about her surrounds and she’s good for people and the planet. She is a little clumsy at this whole romance caper, however. It’s the only aspect of her life she lacks confidence in. We have no idea why.
Wilson: She walks with her eyes pointing down like a criminal, her thumbs inside the sleeves of her jumper, and she rarely shaves her pubic hair. The last I heard she was off to the U.S for a huge meeting of girls.
Win: Her Vietnamese heritage assists her but as one of the most agile and nimble decision makers in the Kingdom, Win always gets what she wants.
Winifred: What a splendid single-minded creature she is. Here's an example - let's say she was interviewed for a job by the tax department - which is possible, given her love of numbers and having things in the right piles - during which she was permitted to bring in a set of tax-department folders as a means to assist her with her answers. If asked a question that she found rather vexing she would have no issues and feel no pressure, there in front of the three-member panel, sifting through the documents for several hours trying to find the answer. In a past life she was a splendid hunting beagle.
Winnie: 21 no matter how old she is, Winnie laughs big. She has a big family as well, none of whom are shy little violets either, and whatever her weight, be it described in kilos or pounds, it will consist of only hilarious buckets of love. Amen.
Winona: “Oh, muuuum,” her sister moans from the lounge room. “Winona has split up with Tommy again....can you tell her to go and cry in her room please??..”
Winsome: The name of that railway line out there in the middle of a big country. Dead straight and stretching to the horizon in both directions, you stand there in the quiet heat of a stinking hot summers' day marvelling at the noise a train would make if it appeared. (i.e. Winsome saves her energy for when it's really needed, and right now she's deep in some kind of meditative slumber.)
Winter: No, her parents couldn't afford to pay the heating bill and here we are. If they spent the money on electricity and not booze perhaps they could have. Then again, without booze Winter may never have existed and we're glad she does. She's a little shy at first but she has a heart of gold. Just stay off the booze baby!
Wrenne: Wrenne bursts onto the scene like a greyhound exploding out of the box. This girl has spunk and energy to burn and 'No', therefore, is a word she rarely utters. And, by God, can she move!
Wylma: Mourful? Not a chance. Yes, she got thrown by the horse again but so what? Before the dust has even settled she's up again ready for another go, hat on head, wry smile on face. It takes a lot to get this girl down and she knows how to ride the bumps.
